children: Shares of Nvidia slid after The Wall Street Journal reported that the company's board is preparing to oust Chief Executive Jensen Huang.
The stock was down 8.5% at $159.00 in late trading on Wednesday. Shares closed up 2.9% at $173.73.
The board is preparing to meet as soon as today to make a decision on Huang's future, the Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

Independent members of the board had been investigating whether Huang was the target of a foreign espionage effort, after he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence source.

Nvidia shares were already falling in post-market trading after the New York Times reported that Huang had a separate extramarital relationship with an Nvidia vice president, citing people who worked at the company.
